title: Pin imap-types and imap-codec alpha versions with exact = constraint
description: Cargo.toml specifies imap-types = "2.0.0-alpha.6" and imap-codec = "2.0.0-alpha.7" without the = (exact) prefix. Under Cargo SemVer rules, alpha pre-release versions are not automatically updated by cargo update (Cargo treats pre-release as strictly less than the release), but a future alpha.7 / alpha.8 of imap-types could be pulled in by cargo update if crates.io publishes it with matching major.minor.patch — because alpha versions within the same major.minor.patch are compared by their pre-release identifiers and Cargo will select the highest matching pre-release. Alpha crates routinely contain breaking API changes between point releases. A solo maintainer running cargo update months later could silently pull a build-breaking or behaviour-changing version. Fix: change to imap-types = "=2.0.0-alpha.6" and imap-codec = "=2.0.0-alpha.7" (exact pins) and add a comment explaining these are intentional alpha pins that must be updated deliberately, not via cargo update.
